en:
<CLT=cltMIND>The moment I entered the dining hall,
I heard an angry shout fill the room.

Q-Quit messing around!
Don't just do whatever you want!
Hmmm? But I have Atua's blessing.

Yeah! We have Atua's blessing! And I'll throw
any degenerate who won't shut up about it!

Hm...I know you claim to be the student council
or somesuch, but this is going too far, yes?

As we've said before, this is all to end the
killing game and keep the peace.
<CLT=cltMIND>What? What is going on?

Kaito, what's wrong?
What are you fighting about?
These guys did something unbelievable.

They blocked the manhole that leads 
to the underground!
The manhole?

Gonta put heavy rocks on top of manhole,
so no one can use it anymore.

I could've made it disappear with my magic, 
but I decided to let Gonta handle it this time.
Why...would you do that?

Cuz the manhole is a reminder of our
desire to leave this place.

We don't want another tragedy to happen
again, like what happened to Kaede.

You said it, Angie! We need to forget all about
that underground tunnel and start fresh!

Dammit! She just does whatever she wants
without even asking our opinion!

It certainly is important to hear everyone's 
opinion, but if we did, nothing would get done.

That's why we just decided to obey 
the student council president!

If it's Angie, then she'll make the right 
decision! She can hear Atua, after all!

Man, she's a lost cause. Plain Janes like her
are total rubes when it comes to cults.

Tsumugi, thank you for your fantastic speech.
I was truly moved by it.
Hmmmmmm...
Ah...

Thank you for always supporting me. Atua smiles
on you for your plain and simple service.

I've been wondering...does Atua have 
red eyes and hair as black as night?
Atua has whatever features you desire.

A red-eyed, black-haired god... Ah, 
what a cool god I have watching me!

When can I meet him!? I want to 
meet him as soon as possible!

Atua exists beyond time itself, but I'm certain
you will feel His presence very soon.
So cool! Atua's just so cool!

...Cults like these can be reaaally
annoying if you get on their bad side.

But, but why are you guys so mad over
the manhole being covered?

Is it cuz you guys wanna use it to escape?
You still haven't given up on leaving here?
You haven't given up?
You haven't given up?
Wh-What the hell's wrong with you guys!?

The student council cannot ignore that.
It seems we must tighten our control.
Tighten...? Are you callin' me loose!?

You were in the computer room past 
nighttime yesterday, weren't you, Miu?
Eh? S-So what if I was!?

So was Maki. She didn't go back to her room
until way past nighttime.
Shuichi...you too, right?
Y-Yeah...

Geez! This isn't good! If your life is in
disarray, your mind and body will be, too.

Atua is right... We must forbid everyone but
the student council from walking at nighttime.
What?

Wh-What!? What I do and where I do it is
none of your fuckin' business!

No, as long as everyone still wants to
leave, that is not acceptable.

Why is the student council exempt from 
your rules? That is blatantly unfair, yes?

Nyahaha! I'm not worried about the student
council. They don't want to leave anymore.

That's right.
Why would we need to go outside anyway?

Here, we have food, clothing, shelter, 
wonderful friends, and best of all, Atua.

What else do you need?
It's not good to be greedy, you know?

Nyahaha! Everyone in the student council
is so divine!

D-Don't be stupid! Are you telling me 
to just stay here and do nothing!?

Like hell I will!
I haven't even gone to space yet!
...ARE-YOU-ALL-FIGHTING?

I-I don't think so! I think that maybe they're
not actually fighting!

Y-Yeah! And even if they were fighting, it
looks like a friendly one!
...What are you here for? We're busy right now.

WE...WANT-YOU-TO-GET-EVEN-CLOSER-
WITH-EACH-OTHER...
SO, WE-BROUGHT-THIS...
A Flashback Light!?

It's part of our "Use the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL> to
restore a new memory...

...and become better friends by talking
about it with each other" plan!

Wow, I've suffered way too many blows to the
head to remember a plan name *that* long.
Ah, let me see that.
AH—!

<CLT=cltMIND>Suddenly, Angie grabbed the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltMIND>
from his hands and...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*crash!*

<CLT=cltMIND>She threw it on the ground and
stomped on it relentlessly!
AH...AHHHHHHHHHH!

Nyaha! The student council has decided that
we will not use <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Lights<CLT=cltNORMAL> anymore.
What!? Wh-Why!?

Because the Flashback Lights only restore
our memories of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
But we don't need those memories anymore.

We realize now that we don't belong in the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
We belong here, at the Ultimate Academy...

O-Oh no...if you don't use the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback
Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>, our plan is a bust...
Wh-What are we gonna do, Monodam!?
Hey! He ran away!

Heyyyyyy Monodaaaaam!
Waaaaait!
Nyahahaha! Bye-onara!
A-Angie...what are you doing!?

We could've remembered something
about the funeral or the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

There's no reason to remember all that.
We're not returning to the outside world.
...Yeah. It pointless now.
Wh-Why you... You've gone way too far!

Even if you want to stop the killing game, 
you're going way too far.
Sorry, but you should take that up with Atua.

Geez, I don't think you're sorry at all. So, do
you have a plan for the "<CLT=cltSTRONG>you-know-what<CLT=cltNORMAL>"?

You mean the <CLT=cltSTRONG>resurrection ritual<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
Oh, we have a plan for that!
Wh-What!?
What...are you planning?

Just a necessary precaution. The more friends
we have, the more fulfilling our lives will be.
A necessary precaution?

Ummm... What if we get another time limit <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
like the one that got Rantaro killed?

...Shouldn't we have a sacrifice prepared, just
in case?

You mean...if someone has to die, we should
volunteer someone we resurrected?

You're going to resurrect someone...just to
kill them all over again?

Kehehe... You have some cruel plans for someone
who wants to stop the killing game.

Life cannot always be fun and smiles... Atua
must make difficult, even cruel, decisions.

But, but! We must submit to Atua's will if
we're to live a peaceful school life.
Atua's will is absolute.

If Atua says so, then there's nothing 
we can do about it.
Nyeeeh...it's just like Atua says.

A-Are you serious about this? Did you forget
that thing's a motive for the killing game?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito...what's going on with you?
You're looking worse and worse...

That <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL> is of no concern to us, as long
as you cast aside your desire to escape.
By the way...who are you going to resurrect?
Wh-What kind of stupid question is that!?

Hmm... After discussing the matter with Atua,
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>transfer student<CLT=cltNORMAL> we will revive is...
...Rantaro Amami!
Rantaro?

Well...we simply cannot resurrect convicted
murderers, such as Kaede and Kirumi...

Nor criminals like Ryoma, who violated the
rule against sharing one's motive video...

Which leaves Rantaro as the only one who'd
be of use to the student council...

<CLT=cltMIND>True, Rantaro was the only one
who knew about the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>They're going to bring him back?

Hey, I have a question.
This might sound a little weird, but...

Does the term <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>
ring a bell for anyone?

<CLT=cltMIND>No... No, this is impossible!
It's not going to happen...
<CLT=cltMIND>...He's dead.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kaede...killed him.

Oh my, it's already so late.
I need to get going now.

I must pray to Atua and begin preparations
for the ritual.

Nyeeeh...you're right.
It's time to pray to handsome Atua.
Well then, let's go.
Nyahahaha! Bye-onara!

<CLT=cltMIND>With Angie leading them, the student
council strolled out of the room.

She acts like she's carrying out Atua's will,
but this is her will, isn't it?

Even so, we cannot defy her right now.
Extreme faith is frightening, indeed.

Then, it's an all-out war against the student
council! Six versus six! We can win this!

Also, we have the assassin on our side!
Let's have her kill them nice and quick!
Ah, no... We have to resolve this peacefully.

Sure, that'd be great, but I don't hear anyone
coming up with a plan to end this peacefully.

...What about you, Kaito? You've been quiet this
whole time. I bet you have some great ideas.
Huh? You say something?
Uh-oh... *Someone* was zoning out.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito...
Something doesn't seem right.

Kaito...what's wrong?
Are you feeling okay?

O-Oh, it's nothing.
I just feel a chill is all...
If I rub some spit on it, it'll feel better.
...Rub spit on what, exactly?

A-Anyway...there's no such thing 
as <CLT=cltSTRONG>resurrecting the dead<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Th-There's no way...
It's just not possib—

Dammit...no.
I can't stop these chills!
Huh?

Sorry guys. My bad.
I-I'm gonna go back to my room.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito left on unsteady feet to
go back to his room.
...What was that about? Is he getting sick?

We were just talking about all that
occult stuff. Maybe he's possessed...
Hahaha! I'm starting to worry about that guy!
You seem to be enjoying this...

<CLT=cltMIND>The rest of us left the dining hall
and went back to our rooms.

Student council has spoken! This decision
for everyone's sake!

<CLT=cltMIND>The decision of the student council...
What does that mean? Is Kaito upset about it?

Uh-ooohh! Trouble already!
Well, I knew this was gonna happen.

Oh, yeah. If we wanna start a war against
the student council...

...we should wait until after the <CLT=cltSTRONG>resurrection
ritual<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Kokichi...you want to go along
with this motive?

Because it sounds fun! Don't you wanna
see the <CLT=cltSTRONG>resurrection ritual<CLT=cltNORMAL>, too!?

Oh, but Angie wants to make Rantaro the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>transfer student<CLT=cltNORMAL>, huh?
I don't want him to come back to life.
Why?

It's cuz...I love you most, Shuichi.
I'm always thinking about you...

And you'd rather see Kaede brought
back to life, huh?
Th-That's...

You're so admirable! 
That's why I wanna support you!
Oh wait, that's a lie!

Come to think of it, I once saw this anime that
was also about a death game...

The mastermind sacrificed a family member as
the first victim to get the killing started.

Sacrificed a family member?
As in...killed them?

Yeah, as a show of force. Maybe that's
what happened to Rantaro...

What if Rantaro was working for the mastermind?
Bringing him back might be a bad idea.

N-No, that's idiotic! Rantaro couldn't have been
working for the mastermind...
<CLT=cltMIND>But...is it really impossible?

<CLT=cltMIND>We only knew Rantaro for a
short time.

<CLT=cltMIND>He did seem as though he was kind
of <CLT=cltSTRONG>used to<CLT=cltMIND> the killing game.

Nee-heehee... Looks like you're starting to
understand what I'm getting at, Shuichi.

Well, no matter what we say, Angie's probably
dead set on who the <CLT=cltSTRONG>transfer student<CLT=cltNORMAL> will be...

If he comes back to life, then that's that!
Nothing we can do except look forward to it!

Well, no matter what we say, Angie's probably
dead set on who the <CLT=cltSTRONG>transfer student<CLT=cltNORMAL> will be...

If he comes back to life, then that's that!
Nothing we can do except look forward to it!

Reliance on a god is unavoidable...
But dependance is problematic.

Dependance is a trait of one with a corrupted 
mind. The only thing we can truly depend on...
...is love!

Men who say creepy things like that are worse
than co-workers who won't stop talking to you.

<CLT=cltMIND>What was that fight all about?
I should hear it from Kaito...

They may call themselves the student council,
but it seems "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Atua<CLT=cltNORMAL>" makes all their decisions.

Meaning they care little for the wishes 
of the students to begin with.

No one can go against Angie at the moment.
But what's even more worrying...

Her followers may begin acting on their
own, using her name as an excuse.
...That's one way of looking at it.

Huh? Are Resting Bitch Face and Creepshow
startin' to feel sympathetic now!?

Er, uh, I mean...I understand what you're
tryin' to say...

But that numbnuts, Kaito, isn't following 
along at all! Explain it for him!
Kaito...?
He's still zoning out.

<CLT=cltMIND>Seems like it... He didn't even respond
to Miu teasing him.

Well, let's just put aside that pathetic mess
for now...

Just explain everything for this stupid bitchlet
and her cow tits.
Ergh... He insulted me!

...Such a situation is common among groups
with absolute leaders.

To gain the favor of their leader...
Or to sacrifice themselves to their faith...

The followers begin to take more
radical actions.

Which means...they might crack down on us
to make Angie's rule more comfortable.
Eh? Rule over us?

Th-That might become a problem down
the line...

Well, I doubt they'd start with that...
But it's only a matter of time.

No one can go against Angie at the moment,
but even more worrying...
Is if her followers begin to act on her will.

Well, I doubt they'd start with that...
But it's only a matter of time.

We're doing this to eradicate the killing game
and bring peace to this school.
You want that too, don't you, Shuichi?

The most important thing is peace in the
academy. That's what we're working towards.
This is for your guys' sakes, too, y'know?

...Go and stop Kaito. Yelling at each
other won't get anything done.

Do you think there's a way to get both sides
to understand each other?
What?
You said it earlier, right?

I...don't know right now. But I know that nothing
will be resolved talking like this.

I don't think the student council members
will change their minds.
True, but...

There are two sides to this... Why don't we
just "remove" one of them?
...What?
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki... Angie...

N-No! We can't do that!
"Removing" them won't resolve anything!

...I know that already. It's just an option
in the world I'm from.
Just...think about it. That's all.
Maki...
Resurrecting the dead is impossible.

And even if it wasn't, would they really
want to come back?

Do you think they'd want to come back
and live through this situation again?
...I wonder.

<CLT=cltMIND>Even if they came back,
the killing game would continue.

<CLT=cltMIND>Just because they've died once
doesn't mean they won't try anything...

What!? Are you defying the student council!?
Don't make me throw you, Shuichi!

I don't understand why everyone's 
getting so mad...

This is so the killing game won't happen 
and we'll have a peaceful life here...

Why is everyone so upset? I've already been
granted permission by Atua!

Fuck your Atua! Don't just act on your own
without hearing our opinions! Mainly mine!

I'm down to <CLT=cltSTRONG>resurrect the dead<CLT=cltNORMAL> if they're just
gonna be sacrificed after comin' back anyway!

Doesn't matter if they die once, twice,
or a hundred times...

As long as they're dyin' instead of me, their
death isn't goin' to waste!
Wh-What...? Why are you glaring at me?

Y-Y-You should wait for your balls to drop
before you try to side-eye me!

Y-Y-You should wait for your balls to drop
before you try to side-eye me!

<CLT=cltMIND>What's going on here?
Is Kaito fighting with the student council?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito...
Something doesn't seem right.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Dining Hall Rules"

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"You may eat any food you
find in the dining hall."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Please take responsibility for all utensils and
dishes used and clean up after yourself."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"The dining hall will be locked
during nighttime."

<CLT=cltMIND>What's going on here?
Is Kaito fighting with the student council?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito...
Something doesn't seem right.
